f_01KXANJ1ZS9BDW02F3DTPEFDEK.subject: job_addition_dimensions
f_01KXANJ1ZS9BDW02F3DTPEFDEK.content: The addition is a two-story structure with an approximate 30' × 10' footprint.

f_01KXANJ1ZXN80SY7BDQRQW8YEE.subject: job_addition_spaces
f_01KXANJ1ZXN80SY7BDQRQW8YEE.content: The addition includes basement-level storage, a second-floor primary bedroom expansion, a master bathroom, and a walk-in closet.

f_01KXANJ1ZYTEEDW4EP14V770VS.subject: job_septic_requirement
f_01KXANJ1ZYTEEDW4EP14V770VS.content: A TDEC septic inspection is required pre-construction; all septic remediation costs are explicitly excluded from the contract and will require a change order.

f_01KXANJ1ZYNBY29R0FS02VFBN1.subject: job_foundation_spec
f_01KXANJ1ZYNBY29R0FS02VFBN1.content: Foundation consists of continuous 12"×12" perimeter concrete footings with 4" gravel base, vapor barrier, rebar/wire mesh, and a 4" smooth concrete slab; no CMU or full-height foundation wall is anticipated.

f_01KXANJ1ZYE8T3A75FDDV9EMY4.subject: job_lvl_beam_spec
f_01KXANJ1ZYE8T3A75FDDV9EMY4.content: One 3-ply 14" LVL beam spanning approximately 15'-6" is required to open an existing load-bearing wall; temporary shoring is included in scope.

f_01KXANJ1ZYA0ZH1VFN6VKZ6H7P.subject: job_roof_system
f_01KXANJ1ZYA0ZH1VFN6VKZ6H7P.content: New gable roof at 3/12 pitch tying into existing 6/12; truss vs. rafter system is TBD in design phase with architectural asphalt shingles and seamless gutters.

f_01KXANJ1ZYRR4BKSCC8G95G1QZ.subject: job_electrical_subpanel_spec
f_01KXANJ1ZYRR4BKSCC8G95G1QZ.content: Electrical scope includes a 100-amp subpanel, approximately 12 recessed lights, and a dedicated 120V/30A circuit for a future elevator.

f_01KXANJ1ZYJYBF6CA2RXTQY7ZW.subject: job_elevator_shaft_scope
f_01KXANJ1ZYJYBF6CA2RXTQY7ZW.content: A future 4'×4' elevator shaft is framed into the structure; the elevator system itself is not included in this contract.

f_01KXANJ1ZZ9Y4QS5KV2KMWWJ5M.subject: job_heat_pump_relocation
f_01KXANJ1ZZ9Y4QS5KV2KMWWJ5M.content: Existing heat pump and electrical disconnect must be relocated during the demo/site work phase.

f_01KXANJ1ZZBTSACA3X1KKN6BCW.subject: job_window_spec
f_01KXANJ1ZZBTSACA3X1KKN6BCW.content: Exterior scope includes four windows — three 36"×60" and one transom — plus one new exterior door.

f_01KXANJ1ZZ6FZJNC8RSP60K4WM.subject: job_estimation_status
f_01KXANJ1ZZ6FZJNC8RSP60K4WM.content: No valuation, breakdown document, or estimation run is attached; this job is in pre-estimation state.
